_design_note:
Prioritized replay again, with the budget its own learning curve asks for. The 5000-round arm measured -0.194 (t = -3.79) and was read as a regression; its curve says it was an unfinished agent. On the loot-crate primary suite it sits below R02_9 at every checkpoint and is still climbing at the end -- 15.14 at 3000, 15.52 at 4000, 16.42 at 5000 -- while R02_9 had already flattened at 16.49 / 16.38 / 16.60. It reached at 5000 rounds what R02_9 reached at 3000, so prioritized sampling on this recipe learns about 1.7x slower per round rather than faster.

The explanation this arm does NOT rest on: the first arm's mean importance weight of 0.40 and gradient norm of 0.486 looked like a 0.4x step size, and are not one. Adam divides by the running RMS of the gradient, so a uniform rescaling cancels -- and the parameter norms agree, 29.72 / 36.18 / 39.16 against R02_9's 29.19 / 35.79 / 38.63. The weights moved the same distance. That reading is withdrawn (section 7.38).

Against the 5000-round PER arm this is a single declared factor: the budget. Against R02_9 it is two, sampling and budget, and the free control for the budget half already exists -- runs/rep_budget, the scalar 10000-round arm, is indistinguishable from R02_9 (t = -0.27).

_predeclared_design_numbers.changed_factor: Budget 5000 -> 10000 against runs/m3_per_5000_vs3rb_20260829, which is the single-factor comparison. Against R02_9 it is sampling plus budget.
_predeclared_design_numbers.control: runs/m3_lr_decay_5000_vs3rb_20260827/ (R02_9), ten repeats of the holdout classic_versus_opponents suite: score 3.6371, sd 0.1214, coins_share 0.3449. This arm's config is that config with one field changed.
_predeclared_design_numbers.falsification: Still distinguishably worse than R02_9 closes prioritized replay on this line for good: both the normalisation and the budget explanations would be dead.
_predeclared_design_numbers.prediction: If the -0.194 was an unfinished agent, this lands near R02_9 and prioritized replay is merely slower, not harmful. If it stays low, the slowness is not the story and prioritized sampling is worse on this recipe at any budget.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reporting: All five training-seed distributions, coins_share and suicides beside every score, and the learning curve on the loot-crate primary suite. Every score names its scenario and whether opponents were present.
_predeclared_design_numbers.resolution_tournament: Two arms measured once each need a gap of 0.246 on the tournament suite (section 7.20.2). The quoted comparison is ten repeats per arm of the same fifteen holdout jobs, Welch, |t| > 2.3.
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_mechanism_check: The loot-crate learning curve must have flattened by 10000 rounds. If it is still climbing, this arm is undertrained too and says nothing except that the budget was again too small.
_predeclared_design_numbers.the_metric_that_decides_it: Official score on classic + 3 rule_based_agent, holdout seeds, ten repeats. That is the competition setting and the only promotion metric.
